messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I want to land PR #2219 (feature/kv-cache-optim) before the Thursday deploy blackout. CI queue is long, wondering if we should grab a rebase slot or request a priority run.
Jon: How long is the CI ETA right now?
CI Bot: PR #2219 currently position 27 in the pipeline; estimated start ~2h 10m given current throughput. Mac E2E shows 2 failing tests (flaky).
Ravi: If we can split the PR into smaller patch that only touches runtime flags, that might land faster. Is the kv change small enough?
Maya: It’s two commits: one runtime toggle + perf test update. I can split but would prefer single landing for the rollout. Rebase will take ~10m.
SRE Oncall: We have a manual canary window at 11:00 UTC we can use to bypass queue if you can rebase and fix the flaky tests by then. Deploy blackout Thu 03:00–06:00 UTC (UTC).
Jon: I can review quick after CI passes. If you want the manual slot, tag @sre-oncall and add the urgency label.
Maya: Ok will rebase now and run the failing tests locally. If they’re flaky, I’ll push a fix and ping for the canary.
Ravi: If you need a priority run instead of canary, @ci-bot can trigger one — what label do you use?
Maya: Use `urgent-merge` label and add a short note in PR body: `[ci priority=manual-canary]`. Also adding the tiny rerun command here in case folks need it:
```bash
./scripts/ci/rerun --pr 2219 --priority canary
```
CI Bot: Manual canary run can be scheduled; requires SRE ack. Current queue will not block a scheduled canary.
SRE Oncall: I’ve reserved the 11:00 UTC slot for this. Please have your PR rebased and tests passing by 10:45 UTC. I’ll trigger the canary then.
Maya: Rebase done, pushed fix for the flaky assertion, running full matrix now. Ping when you’re ready to trigger.
Jon: Will do a quick pass as soon as CI hits green. If anything looks risky we’ll fall back to staged rollout.
Maya: Thanks — pinging again when CI is green. :pray:
CI Bot: Full matrix completed: all checks passed.
Maya: Ready for canary. @SRE Oncall canary slot please.
SRE Oncall: Triggering canary now. Monitoring dashboards and traces open.
DeployBot: Canary deploy initiated for PR #2219 -> group=canary; expected verification 15m.
Jon: I’ll watch logs for latency regressions. Maya lmk if you want me to hold on the final approval.
Maya: If canary looks good, merge after the 15m verification. Will wait for your OK.
SRE Oncall: Canary healthy at +12m, no errors, latency within baseline.
Jon: OK from me, merging after CI/TG checks.
Maya: Merged — thanks everyone. Saved the Thursday blackout. :tada:
